x: The APPSC 2012 key gives 1945: the IMF came into existence on 27 December 1945, when its Articles of Agreement (Bretton Woods, 1944) took effect.
dispute: APPSC 2012 key and most books: 1945. Strictly the IMF began financial operations on 1 March 1947 (NextGen Part 1 APPSC 02 p.15), so 1947 fits 'became operational' better.
